account: It is day 0, shortly after 09:00. I came from home to town hall and read the appointment book. This morning is set aside for office correspondence, followed by a market walk in the plaza at 10:00. Later I am due home for lunch at noon, back for town accounts at 13:00, at an east-bank dockside cottage for tea with the neighbour at 15:00, in the office at 16:30, and home at 19:00. I returned the book to its chest so the secretary can access it. The secretary is here holding a writable book. I asked about correspondence and urgent town business but have heard no answer yet. Several townsfolk have passed outside the hall, including Townsfolk 04, 28, 08, and 06. I have not heard news from them or seen anything that establishes unusual activity. Their purposes, and what the secretary is writing, remain unknown to me. So far this appears to be an ordinary morning of municipal business, not evidence of any particular scheme or emergency.
